chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
“The closest that the servant is to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is while he is in sajdah (prostration).”

key_terms.أَقْرَبُ: nearest; in the state of greatest closeness
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant; the human being in relation to Allah
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; an expression of exaltation for Allah

ai.seo_question: When is a servant closest to Allah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a servant’s state of greatest nearness to Allah, exalted is He, is during sajdah (prostration). It highlights the spiritual rank of humility and devotion in salat (prayer), where the servant is physically lowered before Allah while spiritually drawing nearer to Him.
